cdInviteHint: Find the doctor by name or medical council number. Once they accept, they join the centre's doctors.
cdRejectHint: The doctor is sent this reason.
caNoOffices: No doctor has linked an office to this centre yet. Visits at linked offices show up here.
ofCenterNote: The centre's wallet: licence fees are paid from it and you can withdraw the balance to your bank account. Amounts are in toman.
shipTrackingHint: Enter the Tipax waybill number or the courier's ride code or link. The buyer is told and sees it on the order page.
labResultHint: Send the result as a PDF or image. Only the patient and the lab can see it, and the patient is told.
insNetworkHint: Doctors and centres that accept your insurance. A doctor joins through an insurance request approved by support; centres list it on their profile.
orgReviewsHint: Reviews published on your public page after support's review.
pfPendingRule: Each earning becomes withdrawable ${1} days later
wdPendingNote: Another ${1} toman is in settlement and is added to your withdrawable balance ${2} days after the work is done.
visitDisputeHint: This in-person visit was recorded as done without a check-in. If you were not seen, file an objection.
visitDisputeText: Support will review your objection. If it is upheld, the visit fee goes back to your wallet.
bizSubtitle: Your books are written automatically from visits, sales, settlements and withdrawals; add your other expenses and income here.
bizAutoNote: This voucher comes from a real event (visit, sale, settlement or withdrawal) and cannot be edited or deleted.
manageInventory: Record purchases, receive goods, count stock and pay suppliers
invSubtitle: Stock of every item by batch and expiry; each sale takes the batch that expires first and its cost is booked in your accounts automatically.
invPharmacyHint: Your goods for sale are your pharmacy products. After an item's first purchase or opening stock, every sale on the site leaves stock automatically. Add your own supplies (gloves, syringes, ...) separately.
invReorderHint: When stock falls to the reorder point the item shows under "Needs reorder". The suggested order fills up to the maximum stock, or a month of real use if no maximum is set.
invOpeningHint: Stock you had before Noyan: enter the quantity, purchase price, batch number and expiry.
invUseHint: Supplies used in the work; taken from the batch that expires first and booked as supplies expense.
invCountHint: Enter what you counted on the shelf; the difference from the book stock is recorded as a shortage or surplus automatically.
invReceiveHint: On "Receive", each line enters stock with its own batch and expiry, the discount is spread over the goods' cost, and the supplier payable and input VAT are booked.
invReceiveConfirm: The goods enter stock and the supplier payable is booked. After that the purchase can be cancelled only while none of its goods has been sold or used.
invCancelConfirm: Cancel this purchase? If it was received, its goods leave stock and its voucher is reversed.
managePayroll: Manage employees, payroll and salary, insurance and tax payments
paySubtitle: Monthly payslips under the Labour Law: housing, food and child allowances, overtime, social security and salary tax at the year's legal figures; the accounting voucher and payments are recorded automatically.
payDraftHint: Enter worked days, overtime hours, other earnings and deductions (such as an advance instalment), press "Recompute", and once checked, post the payroll.
payPaySalariesHint: The net pay of all employees is paid from this account.
payPayLiabilitiesHint: Both insurance shares to Social Security and the salary tax to the tax office.
payPostConfirm: This month's payroll voucher goes into the accounts and can no longer be edited; until a payment is recorded you can reopen it.
payReopenConfirm: This month's voucher is reversed and the payroll becomes editable again.
payEmployeeHint: Housing, food and child allowances use the year's legal figures (child allowance for a worker with 720 days of insurance record). The base salary should not be below the minimum wage; the insurance base is never below it.
payAdvanceHint: The advance is paid today and booked to "Staff advances and loans"; it comes back as a deduction in a later month's payroll.
payRulesHint: Noyan sets these figures for every centre from the Supreme Labour Council's decision and that year's budget law; payslips are computed from them.
payNoRules: No year's legal figures are set yet
manageCrm: Add notes, follow-ups and tags, and write campaigns
crmSubtitle: Your patient and customer list builds itself from this centre's bookings and orders; add notes and follow-ups and send them SMS campaigns.
crmAddContactHint: Only add someone who agreed to get this centre's SMS; patients and customers from the site are added automatically.
crmOptOut: Do not send campaign SMS to this person
crmFollowUpText: What to do? (e.g. call for the check-up)
crmFollowUpsHint: The follow-ups you set for patients, overdue first. Open a patient in «Patients and customers» to add one.
crmCampaignsHint: SMS go only to your own patients and customers who haven't opted out, with an opt-out link, after Noyan clears the text, between 8 and 21. The cost comes from the plan's monthly quota, then the wallet; unsent SMS are refunded.
crmCampaignNameHint: For you only; not sent to recipients
crmChars: ${1} characters · ${2} SMS parts (with the opt-out link)
crmTextRules: Start the text with the centre's name; health claims, drug prices and promoting prescription drugs are not allowed, and the text is reviewed before sending.
crmPreviewEmpty: Write the text to see what recipients get
crmNotAffordable: The wallet balance (${1} toman) is not enough; top it up first.
crmApprovalHint: After «Send for approval», Noyan reviews the text; once approved it goes out between 8 and 21 and is charged then.
optIntro: ${1} sent you this SMS through Noyan. Don't want promotional SMS any more?
optAll: Stop promotional SMS from every Noyan centre
optDoneOwner: You won't get promotional SMS from ${1} again.
optDoneAll: You won't get promotional SMS from any Noyan centre again. Your booking and order SMS still arrive.
optNote: You can also block promotional SMS from all senders with *800# through your operator.
manageMoadian: Manage the Moadian link and invoices
moaSubtitle: Every paid visit and sale gets an invoice automatically, sent to the Moadian system with your own signature.
moaSubtitlePlatform: Noyan's invoices to providers: plan purchases, campaign SMS and the monthly commission, signed by Noyan.
moaTileWaiting: Waiting to send or for an answer
moaErrSstid: The goods or service ID for “${1}” is missing from the link settings
moaName: Taxpayer name (as in the Moadian portal)
moaKeyIntro: Noyan creates a key pair for you. The private key stays encrypted on Noyan's server and is only used to sign your invoices; you register the public key in your Moadian portal.
moaHow1: Sign in to your portal at my.tax.gov.ir and open “Tax memory IDs”.
moaHow2: Request a new ID and choose “sent directly by the taxpayer” as the sending method.
moaHow3: Copy the public key below and paste it into the portal (if it asks for a certificate request, upload the CSR file).
moaHow4: Enter the 6-character ID the portal gives you in “Tax memory ID” and save.
moaKeyReplaceConfirm: The current key will be discarded and you must register the new one in the portal again. Continue?
moaCertificateHint: If the portal or a certificate authority issued a certificate for this key, paste it here so it is sent with every signature.
moaCopyFailed: Could not copy; select the text manually
moaItemsHint: Each kind of line is invoiced under a 13-digit ID from the tax organisation's list (stuffid.tax.gov.ir); visits and medicines are VAT-exempt but must still be invoiced.
moaItemsHintPlatform: The 13-digit IDs of Noyan's services from the tax organisation's list (stuffid.tax.gov.ir), and the VAT rate included in Noyan's prices.
moaVatPercent: VAT rate (percent, included in the price)
moaSimulated: Development environment: invoices are not really sent and get a simulated answer.
moaSendHint: When on, every paid visit or sale from then on gets a type-2 invoice (no buyer name) that is sent a few minutes later. If a patient wants an invoice in their name, use “Issue in the buyer's name” in the invoice list.
moaSendHintPlatform: When on, every plan purchase and every finished SMS campaign is invoiced, and each month's commission at the start of the next month. If the provider entered its national or economic code in its own Moadian settings, the invoice is type 1 in its name.
moaInvoicesHint: Invoices made from your visits and sales. Amounts on the invoice itself are in rials.
moaInvoicesHintPlatform: Noyan's invoices to providers. Amounts on the invoice itself are in rials.
moaPacket: Data sent to the Moadian system
moaCancelConfirm: A cancellation invoice will be sent for this invoice. Continue?
moaDropConfirm: This invoice will never be sent. Continue?
moaBuyerHint: The invoice will be sent with the buyer's details (type 1).
moaBuyerHintAccepted: This invoice is registered; Noyan cancels it and issues the same lines again with the buyer's details.
moaBuyerSaved: The invoice in the buyer's name was issued
bizYearsHint: The fiscal year is the Iranian solar year (1 Farvardin to the end of Esfand). Years close in order, oldest first; a closed year is locked against hand-typed vouchers, and an automatic one that arrives late is dated on the first day of the open year.
bizCloseStep1: All income and expense balances are closed into “Retained earnings”.
bizCloseStep2: The closing voucher on the last day of Esfand brings every balance-sheet account to zero.
bizCloseStep3: The opening voucher opens the same balances on 1 Farvardin ${1}.
bizCloseLockNote: After closing, this year's vouchers cannot change. Reports leave out the closing and opening vouchers so the year-end balance sheet is not zeroed; both are in the voucher list.
bizCloseConfirm: Close fiscal year ${1}? Its vouchers will no longer change.
bizReopenConfirm: Reopen fiscal year ${1}? Its closing, year-end and opening vouchers will be removed.
bizNothingToClose: There is no ended year to close
bizWarnPayroll: ${1} payrolls of this year are not posted yet
bizWarnPurchase: ${1} purchase invoices of this year are still drafts
bizActualDateNote: This happened on ${1}, but its year was closed; the voucher is dated on the first day of the open year.
bizClosingNote: This voucher was made by the year-end close; reopening that year removes it.
bizBudgetHint: Set an annual amount for each income and expense account. The budget to date is that amount spread evenly over the ${1} months of the year gone by, compared with the actual figure.
bizCashMismatch: The closing cash does not match the flows
bizCentersHint: Hand-typed and quick entries can be booked to a cost centre (a unit, branch or room); here each centre's income and expense add up. Automatic vouchers sit under “No cost centre”.
payBonusHint: Eid is two months of the last daily wage (at most three months of the minimum wage) and severance one month of the last wage, both pro rata to the days worked in the year. Make one list for everyone each Esfand; a separate settlement for anyone who leaves mid-year. Neither is insured; severance is tax-free and Eid above the monthly exemption is taxed.
payBonusRules: Days worked come from this year's posted payrolls (or the hire date), out of the year's ${1} days; you can correct them here.
payBonusPostConfirm: Post the list? Eid and severance expense, what is owed to the staff and the tax are booked.
payTaminDetailsHint: Needed for the monthly insurance disk. Take the 6-digit job code from Tamin's list of occupations.
payDiskHint: You get this month's DSKKAR00.DBF and DSKWOR00.DBF in one zip; upload them at es.tamin.ir or into the List Disk software. Amounts are in rials.
payDiskReady: The disk for ${1} insured people is ready
payDiskFailed: The disk could not be made
payTaxDiskHint: You get WP (staff) and WH (this month's pay and tax) in one zip to upload at my.tax.gov.ir. The same two lists with column names come as CSV, to check in Excel. Amounts are in rials.
payTaxBonusIncluded: This month's posted Eid and severance are included.
payTaxFailed: The tax files could not be made
payTaxDetailsHint: Needed for the monthly salary tax files.
payHireDateTaxHint: The start with this employer, even before Noyan; the salary tax list's "months worked since the start of the year" is counted from it.
bizVatHint: Each quarter's sales come from the invoices registered with Moadian, and purchases and VAT from the books: the same figures the tax portal pre-fills in the return. The return is due by the 15th of the month after the quarter.
bizVatPendingInv: ${1} invoices are not registered with Moadian yet and are not in these figures
bizVatRejectedInv: ${1} invoices were rejected; fix them in Moadian and send them again
bizVatGap: Sales VAT in the books differs from the Moadian invoices by ${1} toman; check sales with no invoice or invoices not yet sent
bizVatUnpaid: ${1} toman of earlier quarters' VAT is still unpaid
bizVatWithCode: From suppliers with an economic code (deductible)
bizVatWithoutCode: From suppliers without an economic code (not deductible)
bizVatSettle: Settle the quarter and post the offset
moaPinvHint: Invoices sellers registered for this centre in Moadian come from the taxpayer portal: export the «purchase invoices» list to Excel there and upload it here. Each invoice is paired automatically with a purchase of the same supplier (economic code) and amount; pair the rest with a purchase or book them as an expense. Only the VAT of paired, unrejected invoices is deductible in the quarterly return.
moaPinvRejectedNote: This invoice was rejected in the portal; its VAT is not deductible.
moaPinvLinkHint: Received purchases from two months around the invoice date that have no invoice yet.
moaPinvExpenseHint: For rent, repairs and services not bought as stock: an expense and its deductible VAT are booked against what is owed to the seller.
moaPinvPairedWith: Paired with the purchase from ${1} on ${2} for ${3}
bizVatBasisMoadian: This quarter's purchase invoices were brought in from the portal; purchase VAT is deductible when it is paired with an unrejected Moadian invoice.
bizVatBasisCode: No purchase invoices were brought in from the portal for this quarter yet; until then, VAT from suppliers with an economic code counts as deductible.
bizVatPinvOpen: ${1} Moadian purchase invoices are not paired with a purchase or expense yet; their VAT is not deductible until then
formUnsavedChanges: Changes aren't saved yet; press Save to apply them.
reviewClosedNoVisit: Ratings and reviews are accepted only from patients who had a visit here, so scores stay real and trustworthy. You can leave a review after your visit.
reviewClosedNoPurchase: Ratings and reviews are accepted only from buyers whose order was delivered, so scores stay real. You can leave a review once your order arrives.
reviewClosedAlready: You have already reviewed every visit or purchase you made here; each visit or purchase gets one review.
reviewBookVisitLink: Book a visit with this centre's doctors
reviewWillBeVerified: Your review will be published with this badge after moderation.
replyPlaceholder: Your reply is shown to everyone under this review, and you can reply only once.

rxMissing: Please enter the prescription tracking code and national ID, or a photo of the prescription
rxApproveHint: Check the tracking code in the Tamin / Salamat system, or the prescription photo. Once approved, prepare and fulfill this item.
rxRejectHint: Rejecting the prescription cancels this item and refunds it to the buyer's wallet. Write the reason for the buyer.
rxRejectReasonRequired: Write the reason for rejecting (at least 3 characters)
rxApprovedDone: Prescription approved; you can now prepare and fulfill the item
rxRejectedDone: Prescription rejected; the item was refunded to the buyer

drugSafetyNote: Do not start or stop a medicine without asking a doctor or pharmacist. If you have a severe reaction (such as shortness of breath or swelling of the face and lips) or have taken too much, call emergency services (${1} in Iran) right away.
licensePromoCodeInvalid: This code isn't valid for this plan

pricingNoPlans: No plans have been published for this section yet
visitAiNotInPlan: The AI visit assistant is in the Premium plan; upgrade your plan to turn it on

proYouAreMember: You're a Pro member; the benefits are on your account.

finOverviewNote: Every figure is read from your books; Noyan visits, orders, settlements and withdrawals are booked automatically.
finUpcomingCheques: Cheques due in the next 30 days
finChequeAlert: You have ${1} overdue and ${2} bounced cheques.
finNoUpcomingCheques: No cheques fall due in the next 30 days.

finHasInsurer: An insurer pays part of it
finPlatformInvoiceNote: This invoice comes from a visit or order paid on Noyan; it was paid from the patient’s wallet and is already in your books.
finSmsNotSent: The SMS was not sent; copy the link and send it yourself.

finNoTill: No cash box or account for this method
finTooMuch: The amount is more than what is still open.
finVoidPaymentConfirm: Void this receipt or payment? Its vouchers will be reversed.

finChqHintReturned: The cheque was handed back to its drawer and is no longer tracked; the debt stays open.
finChqReminderNote: You get a reminder in your panel notifications three days before each cheque falls due.
finTillsHint: Each cash box or account is a ledger account under “Cash and banks” in your books; balances are read from the vouchers.
finReconcileHint: Tick the lines that appear on the bank statement; the cleared balance is compared with the statement balance.
finExpensesSubtitle: Rent, bills, supplies, the contracted lab and more, with vendor, VAT, cost centre and the receipt’s photo; once or recurring.
finRecurringHint: From the date above, a new expense is written every period (paid from the same cash box if “Paid now” is on).
finPayrollNote: Staff salaries are booked in Payroll, with insurance and tax, not here.
finVoidExpenseConfirm: Void this expense? Its voucher will be reversed.
finClaimsSubtitle: Monthly lists of the insurer’s share to Tamin, Salamat, the armed forces’ insurer and supplementary insurers: submit, collect, deductions and aging.
finClaimFromInvoices: Insurer share of invoices not yet claimed
finNoCandidates: No invoices with this insurer’s share are waiting to be claimed.
finReopenConfirm: The claim goes back to draft and its vouchers and deductions are reversed. Continue?

finReportsSubtitle: Profit and loss, balance sheet, cash flow and trial balance; income by service, doctor and insurer; receivables aging. All exportable to CSV.

crmNavDashboardHint: Your patients, upcoming follow-ups, birthdays, message results and SMS credit at a glance.
crmNavContactsHint: Built automatically from this centre's bookings and orders, plus hand-added and imported contacts: search, filter, tag, import and export.
crmNavSegmentsHint: Saved, live filters such as “no visit in 6 months” or “birthday this month”; their counts are always current and they can be a campaign's audience.
crmNavCampaignsHint: SMS to a segment or your own selection, with variables and a tracked booking link, scheduling and a cost preview; sent once Noyan clears the text.
crmNavAutomationsHint: Automatic patient journeys: recall after a visit, thank-you and review request, birthday greeting, missed-visit follow-up, lapsed-patient win-back and chronic-patient check-ups.
crmNavFollowUpsHint: Patient follow-up tasks with a due date and an owner (you or a secretary); an in-app reminder comes when one falls due.
crmNavTemplatesHint: Ready texts with variables and an SMS part counter; each template is cleared once by Noyan, then automations can use it.
crmAttributionHint: “Clicked” means the recipient opened the message's tracked link; “Booked” means the same patient booked with this centre within 14 days of the message.
crmSelectionN: The ${1} contacts you selected in the list
crmAutoRecallHint: A reminder some days after a visit (say 6 months for a check-up or cleaning); not sent if the patient has already booked again.
crmAutoThanksHint: A few hours after a completed visit, a thank-you with the link to that visit's verified review form ({review}).
crmAutoBirthdayHint: On the patient's (Jalali) birthday, once a year, for patients whose birth date is on file.
crmAutoNoShowHint: A few hours after a visit the patient missed, an invitation to rebook; not sent if they already did.
crmAutoWinbackHint: When a patient passes N days with no visit or order, one invitation; at most once a year.
crmAutoChronicHint: For patients tagged with a condition (say diabetes or hypertension), a periodic check-up reminder N days after their last visit.
crmAutoDeleteConfirm: Delete the automation “${1}”? The record of messages already sent is kept.
crmAutoErrCredit: The quota and wallet did not cover every message; the rest go out on a later run.
crmAutoErrModule: Your current plan does not include patient relations; nothing is sent.
crmAutoErrTemplate: This automation's template is not approved (or was edited); nothing is sent until it is approved again.
crmAutoGap: Minimum days between two automated SMS to one patient
crmAutoOn: Automation on: new events get messages from now on
crmAutoOncePerYear: At most once a year per patient
crmAutoSafety: Only an approved template, only in the send window, never to a patient who opted out, never twice for one event; paid from the plan's quota, then the wallet. Switching on never messages the whole history at once.
crmAutoTplNotApproved: This template is not approved yet; you can switch the automation on once Noyan approves it.
crmCharsLine: ${1} characters · ${2} SMS parts (with the link and the opt-out line)
crmDashRecalls: Automated messages in the next 7 days
crmExportFailed: The file could not be downloaded
crmImportHint: A CSV or Excel (xlsx) file with a mobile column; other columns (name, gender, birth date in Jalali or Gregorian, city, insurer, tags) are optional. A repeated number becomes one contact and is merged with an existing one.
crmImportRows: ${1} rows in “${2}”; pick the column for each field.
crmImportConsent: I confirm these people are this centre's own patients or customers and may receive its SMS.
crmNoApprovedTemplates: You have no approved template yet; create one under “SMS templates” and send it for approval.
crmNoSegments: No segments yet; make one from the patient list's filters or with “New segment”.
crmNoTemplates: No templates yet; start from the suggested texts below.
crmNotePlaceholder: A note or a call summary…
crmRuleNewDays: Added in the last N days
crmRuleNoShowDays: A no-show in the last N days
crmSendAsap: After approval, at the first allowed hour
crmSmsCostHint: The cost comes from the plan's monthly quota first, then the wallet; SMS go out only between 08:00 and 21:00.

crmSumNoShow: a no-show in the last ${1} days

crmTplReapprove: Changing the text sends the template for approval again and pauses its automations until then.

accApproversHint: In order; each person decides after the previous one approves.

accCentersTreeHint: Arrange centres as a tree; each centre's report includes its sub-centres.
accCheckbookHint: Keep each chequebook's leaves and which ones are used.

accChqRevertConfirm: Undo this cheque's last status change and its voucher?
